name: A throne in reach
description: Red's Raja is two steps from Green's empty throne, and Green's last Elephant is on the board: sat on, the throne gives Red command of it. Black is to roll, and can guard e8 or take the Raja.

name: Two Elephants against lone Rajas
description: Black and Green have an Elephant each besides their Rajas; Yellow and Red, their Rajas alone. Black is to roll: close in, or let them run.

name: A lead to keep
description: Black and Green lead by 14 points, with even pieces on the board. Yellow is to roll: can the leaders keep it, or will they throw it away?

name: The last Elephant
description: Each side has one Elephant left, and Rajas; Red's Raja stands near Black's empty throne. Green is to roll.

name: Behind on points, ahead on the board
description: Yellow and Red trail by 11 points but have an Elephant more. Black is to roll: can Yellow and Red turn it round?
